camel_example: aliyun cas ListCsr --region cn-hangzhou --CurrentPage 1 --KeyWord test_name --ShowSize 10 --Algorithm RSA
description_en: Queries the certificate signing requests (CSRs) in your account
description_zh: 查询CSR列表信息及CSR详细信息
kebab_example: aliyun cas list-csr --key-word test_name --algorithm RSA --current-page 1 --show-size 10 --api-version 2020-04-07 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListCsr

parameters.help_en: The keyword for fuzzy search. For example, you can specify a domain name
parameters.help_zh: 主域名或者CSR名称关键字
parameters.name: key_word

parameters.help_en: The algorithm. Valid values: RSA, ECC, and SM2
parameters.name: algorithm

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page. Default value: 50
parameters.name: show_size

Algorithm.description_en: The algorithm. Valid values: RSA, SM2, and ECC

CommonName.description_en: The primary domain name, which is a common name

CountryCode.description_en: The code of the country or region in which the organization is located. For example, you can use CN to indicate China and use US to indicate the United States. The default value is the code of the country or region in which the organization is located. The organization is associated with the intermediate CA certificate from which the certificate is issued. For more information about country codes, see the "Country codes" section of the [Manage company profiles]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/198289.html） topic
CountryCode.description_zh: 证书组织机构所在国家或地区的代码。例如，CN表示中国，US表示美国

Department.description_en: The department that uses the certificate

HasPrivateKey.description_en: Indicates whether the certificate contains a private key

KeySha2.description_en: The public key that is calculated by using the SHA256 algorithm
KeySha2.description_zh: 使用SHA256算法处理公钥后的值

KeySize.description_en: The key length that is used by the algorithm. The key length for RSA algorithms can be 2,048, 3,072, and 4,096 bits. The key length for ECC and SM2 algorithms can be 256 bits
KeySize.description_zh:
密钥算法长度。
RSA算法长度一般为2048、3072或4096等。
ECC和SM2算法长度一般为256

Locality.description_en: The city where the company is located

Sans.description_en: The secondary domain names. Separate multiple domain names with commas (,)
Sans.description_zh: 备用名称，申请同一SSL证书的其他域名

CurrentPage.description_zh: CSR所在页码。如果未传入CurrentPage则不返回

RequestId.description_zh: 本次调用请求的ID，是由阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符，可用于排查和定位问题

ShowSize.description_en: The number of entries per page. Default value: 50
ShowSize.description_zh: CSR所在分页。如果未传入ShowSize则不返回

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of entries returned
